captions.detailed: A wireless electronic dropper seatpost featuring a dark, round outer tube and a smooth, silver-metallic inner actuator post. The inner post moves vertically along a prismatic joint, topped with a single-bolt saddle rail clamp plate. A small battery compartment with a screw-cap is located on the side of the lower tube, while a molded black composite saddle rests on dual steel rails that attach to the clamp with a tilt-adjust revolute pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a CAD model of a wireless electronic dropper seatpost with a dark outer tube, a silver inner actuator post on a prismatic joint, a side-mounted battery compartment with a screw-cap, and a saddle assembly with dual steel rails on a tilt-adjustable clamp plate.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner actuator post using concentric Cylinder primitives, setting up a prismatic joint between them. Model the battery compartment on the side of the outer tube using a combination of a small cylinder and a thin disc for the screw-cap. Build the saddle rail clamp plate using Box and Cylinder operations, and represent the saddle and its rails using extruded profiles or curved sweeps, connecting them via a revolute joint to allow tilt adjustment.
